title: 1:1 prep — API/Console/Dedicated/Private (operational pulse)
body:
Meeting: weekly PM <> Eng Lead 1:1 (short ops pulse)
Date: 2026-03-11 (prep notes)
Duration target: 25 min
Primary goals for this meeting:
- Quick unblock for Dedicated capacity rollout (can we meet target throughput for T-1 customers?)
- Confirm fallback routing plan for hosted API during spike events (auto-fallback to slim quantized variants)
- Surface any latent Private deployment risks for Q2 pilot (networking/KMS integration items)
- Agree on 3 immediate action items and owners

Agenda (condensed)
1) 5m — Health snapshot: key metrics I want visible
   - Hosted API: p95 gen latency (current): 160ms (target 120ms)
   - Cost per 1k tokens (hosted): $0.42 (target $0.35)
   - Dedicated pool utilization (eu-west-1 pool-b): 88% peak, 62% avg
   - Private pilot: 2 active customers, one failing post-deploy smoke tests (network path)

2) 7m — Dedicated rollout blockers
   - Autoscale sometimes overshoots -> leads to noisy neighbor throttles (see DED-421)
   - Ask: can we add a conservative cap (soft limit) to new reserve autoscale policy while we fix scheduling jitter?
   - Quick data ask: what's the p99 tail source? kernel scheduling or batch formation? (need perf traces)

3) 7m — Hosted routing/fallback strategy
   - Current behavior: when capacity tight, requests queue for 3s before erroring; fallback disabled for some enterprise tenants (opt-out).
   - Proposal: enable fallback to quantized/shorter context variants by default with opt-out flag for enterprise first week after rollout.
   - Risk note: need to ensure eval harness (quality monitors) flags regression within 5 minutes; otherwise revert automatically.

4) 4m — Private deployment blockers & next steps
   - Failing smoke test on customer infra: KMS handshake intermittent (error 502 -> request retry loop creates cache pressure).
   - Ask: we should schedule an on-call pairing with SRE + Private infra owner this week. Can your team spare 4 hrs?

5) 2m — Confirm action items + sync points + Slack follow-ups

Notes / context (shorthand, to expand if asked)
- Latency tail: preliminary traces show KV cache thrash for sequences >2k. Could be client reuse patterns + small batch sizes. Hypothesis: prefix caching not hitting due to session token mismatch on the gateway (ticketed INF-8932).
- Dedicated autoscale: observed scale-up overshoot when two large bursts happen within the same 30s window; scheduler treats them as separate and spins new instances instead of queueing. Potential mitigation: short coalescing window or token bucket on scheduler.
- Fallback UX: product wants no visible error to end-user (return degraded but correct text). That means we need to wire in quality-preserving post-filtering + confidence scoring (work in GH PR runtime#4721).

Open questions I want to resolve in meeting (explicit)
- Can we commit to a short-term autoscale soft-cap for pool-b in eu-west-1? (yes/no)
- If we enable default fallback, how long until quality monitors run reliably? Is 5m realistic?
- Do we have an on-call pairing slot this week for Private pilot customer A? (need 4 hours)

Proposed immediate action items (assign & dates)
- A1: Add conservative soft-cap to Dedicated pool-b autoscaler; telemetry flag + rollback plan. Owner: Ravi. Due: 2026-03-17.
- A2: Trace-level capture for p99 latency for sequences >2k; collect 48h of samples and annotate KV cache hits/misses. Owner: Ashlyn. Due: 2026-03-16.
- A3: Book Private-deploy pairing session with SRE + Customer A, include KMS logs and endpoint replay. Owner: Dmitri (I'll coordinate). Due: 2026-03-12.
- A4: Small runtime PR to enable fallback-by-default behind a feature flag + integrate quick eval hook. Owner: Eng runtime oncall (Ravi + Ashlyn) to shepherd PR redwood-inference/runtime#4721. Due: 2026-03-20.

Follow-ups I will do (PM side)
- Prepare a short customer-facing note describing fallback behavior for enterprise tenants and opt-out path. (Dmitri)
- Update the rollout tracker and change window -> link in Slack #product-launch. (Dmitri)

Risks / mitigation quick list (to call out)
- Risk: Enabling fallback too broadly could cause unnoticed quality regressions for high-SLA customers. Mitigation: opt-out and fast revert path + early warning alerts.
- Risk: Autoscale cap could increase queueing/latency. Mitigation: temporary cap + telemetry + staged rollback.
- Risk: Private KMS retries causing cache pressure -> affect other customers. Mitigation: isolate pilot to separate pool or enforce aggressive circuit breaker.

Misc scratch (notes to self)
- Bring up tie-in with Optimize team suggestions: batching suggestions could reduce cost per token quickly (short-term wins).
- Remind Eng Lead about upcoming exec demo (2026-03-22) for Dedicated SLA improvements — need live numbers by 2026-03-18.

End of prep. Keep this light during the meeting — focus on decisions for A1-A3 and timeline commitments.
summary: Short operational 1:1 prep for PM (Dmitri) with Eng Lead — latency/cost pulse, Dedicated autoscale blocker, hosted fallback plan, Private pilot KMS issue. Three immediate actions assigned with owners and due dates.
